pt.heroTitle: Direção de arte que funciona no mundo real.

pt.aboutText: Diretor de Arte Sênior especializado em branding institucional, comunicação visual, grandes formatos, sinalização, arte-finalização e integração responsável de IA generativa. Atuação remota para agências, estúdios e empresas.

en.heroTitle: Art direction built for the real world.
en.heroText: For 27 years, I have connected strategy, visual systems, and production — from institutional identity to large-format environments.

en.aboutText: Senior Art Director specializing in institutional branding, visual communication, large formats, signage, production artwork, and responsible integration of generative AI. Available remotely for agencies, studios, and companies.
en.contactText: Project-based or ongoing collaboration for agencies, studios, institutions, and companies that need senior experience without expanding their permanent team.
